mechanism: Statins deplete CoQ10 levels by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase in the mevalonate pathway, which is upstream of CoQ10 synthesis, potentially contributing to statin-induced myopathy and reducing mitochondrial function.
action: Monitor for muscle symptoms; consider CoQ10 supplementation (100-200 mg daily) if patient develops myalgia or documented CoQ10 deficiency, as evidence supports benefits in statin-intolerant patients.
